evidence.text: Materials and Methods In this retrospective and multicenter study, a deep learning model, the COVID-19 detection neural network (COVNet), was developed to extract visual features from volumetric chest CT scans for the detection of COVID-19.
Results The collected dataset consisted of 4352 chest CT scans from 3322 patients.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Using Artificial Intelligence to Detect COVID-19 and Community-acquired Pneumonia Based on Pulmonary CT: Evaluation of the Diagnostic Accuracy》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】Diagnostic performance was assessed with the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, sensitivity, and specificity.

【Abstract · abstract-1-10】The per-scan sensitivity and specificity for detecting COVID-19 in the independent test set was 90% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 83%, 94%; 114 of 127 scans) and 96% (95% CI: 93%, 98%; 294 of 307 scans), respectively, with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.96 (P < .001).

evidence.text: Diagnostic performance was assessed with the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, sensitivity, and specificity.

The per-scan sensitivity and specificity for detecting COVID-19 in the independent test set was 90% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 83%, 94%; 114 of 127 scans) and 96% (95% CI: 93%, 98%; 294 of 307 scans), respectively, with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.96 (P < .001).
